title: Latest revenue partition cannot complete its daily refresh
summary: The daily revenue model refresh fails on its newest partition while dashboards for prior periods remain available.
precursor: Billing event volume and field coverage expanded during the quarter-close reporting window, while other marts continued refreshing.
impact: Finance dashboards remain stale for the latest reporting interval and four downstream reports miss their morning delivery target.

title: Engagement aggregates trail recent product activity
summary: Fresh product-usage events arrive well after ingestion, and hourly engagement aggregates are falling behind their normal refresh cadence.
precursor: A mobile release drove a morning peak in late-arriving session events across several high-volume customer partitions.
impact: Growth dashboards and churn-risk alerts use outdated activity counts until the delayed event batches are processed.

title: Campaign reports lose partner-attributed rows
summary: Completed campaign reports contain missing or unclassified partner-attributed rows even though first-party totals remain within their usual range.
precursor: The campaign ingestion feed resumed after its scheduled maintenance window, and the next enrichment run processed a larger-than-usual batch.
impact: Partner return-on-spend reports undercount attributed conversions, delaying budget reconciliation and campaign adjustments.

title: Large segment snapshots stop before publication
summary: Large customer-segment snapshots terminate before publishing, while smaller segment runs complete and remain current.
precursor: End-of-month activity increased the number of qualifying events included in the scheduled customer snapshot window.
impact: Marketing exports continue using yesterday's membership, leaving newly eligible customers out of scheduled campaigns.

title: Nightly finance extracts are missing from the warehouse
summary: Scheduled finance extracts complete in the source system but do not appear in the reporting warehouse; source-side queries remain available.
precursor: A routine access-maintenance window completed shortly before the first missed scheduled delivery.
impact: The finance close model cannot reconcile the latest ledger snapshot, delaying morning variance review for accounting teams.
